text: An orchard worker from {Place}, {Name} led relatives away from fighting along familiar farm roads. Among displaced families, the sociable picker entertained new friends with stories from years on the harvest crews.
self_review: An orchard worker guided relatives away from fighting and shared stories of working life with other displaced people.
source_pattern: The supplied Rae Kushner biography documents fleeing with relatives and living among a larger group of displaced people.
fictional_changes: The orchard, farm roads, guidance of relatives, and storytelling are invented. No historical escape route or family sequence is copied.
